symbols.read: Bias has shifted to bullish: price rose from 345.49 to 349.93, the combined 1D+1H signal flipped from HOLD to BUY, and the 1H trend remains up. Price is now pressing against the 351.73 entry trigger, which still caps as resistance; a push through it opens the 377.65 target with 349.82 as the stop. The prior bearish FVG at 345.28–345.33 is now backed by two bullish FVGs (345.28–348.36 and 345.80–347.30) acting as support beneath price. Invalidation: a close below 349.82 returns the stance to neutral, while a break below 325.81 kills the bullish 1D structure.

The cautious long bias is now broken: price at 246.30 has lost the 249.12 FVG floor and sits directly on the 246.08 lower pivot, with the 1H trend flipped down and the combined signal downgraded from BUY to HOLD. The prior invalidation condition (a decisive loss of 249.12) has triggered, so the long is dead and the SELL (WATCHING) setup at 246.08 is now live at the pivot rather than parked below it. Bias flips to neutral-to-short: a break of 246.08 opens the 226.82 target with stop 248.14, while reclaiming 248.20 and the remaining bull FVG at 251.27–251.48 would revive the upside toward 265.34 and invalidate the short.

AVGO's bias stays neutral-to-bearish but the picture has weakened: price slipped from 349.91 to 344.43, filling the lowest bull FVG at 343.12–344.35 and leaving only two stacked bull FVGs (346.90–347.00 and 347.41–347.50) overhead as now-resistance rather than support. The 1H uptrend still holds and the combined view remains HOLD against the bearish 1D, with no break of the 338.03 bear trigger yet, so the setup is unchanged in structure but closer to activation. The bear case triggers on a sustained break below 338.03, targeting 320.23 and then 259.62, with stop at 323.59. A sustained move above 380.84 invalidates the bearish structure and flips to the long side (entry 380.84, stop 377.29, target 441.45).

Price has reclaimed the 742.48–748.18 bear FVG and now sits at 749.80, flipping the 1H trend up and the combined regime from SELL back to BUY — a clear revision of the prior bearish bias, with the 732.45 downside target now off the table. The two open bull FVGs at 742.17–742.62 and 745.95–748.14 now act as support shelves beneath price, and the prior 754.29 BUY setup is live again (entry 754.29, stop 753.06, target 776.13) though flagged invalidated pending a trigger. Bias is now neutral-to-bullish toward the 754.29 upper pivot; a sustained break above 754.29 confirms the long toward 776.13. Invalidation: a loss of the 745.95–748.14 bull FVG, and decisively a break below 742.17, would undo the reclaim and restore the bearish structure.

BRK.B has flipped from HOLD to BUY (WATCHING) but price fell to 545.78, now below the 549.96 upper pivot, so the prior bullish breakout bias is revised to neutral until the pivot is reclaimed. The 1D direction stays bullish and the 1H trend is up with the last bar ticking 543.97→544.20, but momentum is weak and there are still no open FVGs beneath price to cushion a pullback. The setup is a watch: entry triggers on a reclaim of 549.96 with stop 547.93 and target 603.96, while a loss of 549.96 keeps price exposed to the 538.58–539.20 shelf and the 495.96 lower pivot.

Bias flips from HOLD to BUY: price at 81,406.01 has cleared the 81,106.15–81,160.00 bear FVG that capped the prior read, and the 4H has turned bullish with the 1H trend now up, confirming the relief bounce as a genuine shift rather than a fade. The 80,451.18 lower pivot has held as support and the 80,418.67–81,178.31 bull FVG sits directly beneath price as the demand zone to defend. The prior SELL setup (entry 80,451.18, target 76,004.36) is invalidated and 76,004.36 is no longer the active objective; upside focus is 84,898.00. Invalidation of the BUY is a close back below 80,418.67 that fills the bull gap and reclaims the broken bear FVG, which would reopen the downside.

Bias flips to bullish: price at 2,358.12 has reclaimed the 2,351.55 lower pivot that previously capped upside, and with 4H direction now bullish, 1H trend up, and the combined stance at BUY, the prior bearish lean is voided. The overhead bear FVG at 2,354.51–2,354.82 that reinforced the old invalidation zone has been absorbed, and the bull FVG at 2,332.32–2,344.74 now sits below price as support. The SELL signal is confirmed INVALIDATED with stop 2,351.74 at entry, so no live trade exists; 2,351.55 is the level to hold as support, with 2,526.62 the upside pivot. Invalidation of the bullish read is a sustained drop back below 2,351.55, which would reopen 2,176.48 as the downside target.

Bias stays SELL and the short remains live: price at 285.11 has extended well below the 316.60 entry and 319.11 stop, with the 1H trend down and the 1D bearish under a combined SELL. The prior read is confirmed and strengthened — the move from 301.70 to 285.11 is a further ~5.5% slide in the trade's favor, and the open-FVG list is still empty, so the 317.86–319.98 shelf stays sliced with no new imbalance to defend. The only structural note is that 316.60 now reads as the lower pivot overhead, reinforcing it as the invalidation line rather than a nearby entry reference. Target remains 273.80; invalidation is a reclaim back above 316.60, and any push back through 319.11 would neutralize the break. Regime is NEUTRAL, so size accordingly.

LLY has broken decisively above the 1,321.21 entry, now trading at 1,385.00 (+6.9% from the prior read's 1,295.59), so the long-leaning bias is now confirmed and active rather than pending — the setup is armed with price well clear of both entry and the 1,309.67 stop. The 1D bullish and combined 1D+1H BUY regime hold, the 1H trend remains up, and FVGs stay empty, with no trend flip or gap fill to flag. Bias is long toward the 1,511.21 target; the invalidation is a break back below 1,309.67, which would void the position and reopen downside toward the 1,131.21 lower pivot. The one caution is the muted last 1H bar (1,372.49→1,374.55, +0.15%), suggesting momentum is consolidating after the run rather than accelerating.

META's SELL bias has flipped to EXPIRED: price at 633.96 has reclaimed the 633.27 entry and pushed above the 629.16 stop, so the short is invalidated and the prior read's "watch-for-rejection" caution resolved into a stop-out rather than a trigger. The 1H downtrend and 1D+1H HOLD remain, but the last 1H bar (628.44→630.77, +0.37%) shows buyers pressing into the 635.10–639.80 bearish FVG, which now caps upside alongside the 648.42–650.38 FVG above. The 633.27 level flips to support and the 625.80–627.80 bull FVG is the downside cushion; a clean break below 633.27 reopens the bear case, while acceptance above 639.80 confirms the reclaim. Bias is neutral-to-cautious-long into resistance, not a fresh short.

MSFT's WATCHING bias holds and tilts further defensive: price slipped to 524.61 from 536.68, the 1H trend has flipped from up to down, and the combined 1D+1H signal has downgraded from BUY to HOLD, so the prior read's caution was warranted and the setup has deteriorated rather than repaired. The 551.15 breakout level remains lost and now sits well overhead, with 510.31 the downside pivot that price is drifting toward. The last 1H bar's 523.25→525.22 bounce is a minor uptick within a downtrend, not a reclaim, and the NEUTRAL regime keeps conviction low. Bias stays WATCHING; a decisive close back above 551.15 is needed to re-validate the long toward 591.99, while a break of 510.31 confirms the bearish path.

Bias stays bearish and the setup has tightened: price is 213.34, still capped below the 221.32 invalidation and now just 3.16 points above the 210.18 entry trigger, with the combined 1D+1H regime flipped to SELL and the 1H trend continuing down (214.01→213.55). What changed since the prior read is the FVG picture — the lone bull gap at 212.30–212.61 is gone and a bear FVG has opened overhead at 215.33–216.33, removing the cushion between price and the trigger and reinforcing downward momentum toward 210.18 and then 176.99. The 212.04 stop still caps risk just below entry, and invalidation remains a sustained reclaim of 221.32.

The prior neutral stance with a bearish lean is now void: price at 102.00 has closed above the 101.55 invalidation and the 101.14 pivot, flipping 4H direction to bullish and the combined read to BUY, with 1H trending up. The overhead 101.86–102.27 gap has been consumed, and the only open FVG is now bullish at 100.96–101.74, which acts as support on a pullback rather than supply. Bias is bullish, with 101.14 the level to hold and 101.55 the line that must not break to keep the upside intact; losing 101.14 reopens the downside toward 93.08.

TSLA's long bias stays intact but has weakened: price dropped from 422.66 to 405.50, giving back most of the push toward the 431.84 target while still holding above the 388.86 upper pivot. The 1D direction remains Bullish and the combined signal still reads HOLD, with the 1H trend up and a shallow -0.04% pullback leg, so structure is unbroken but momentum has clearly faded. Bias remains long above 388.86 with stop 385.35 and target 431.84, though the entry is now expired and price sits closer to invalidation than in the prior read. Invalidation is a close back below 388.86, and a break of 345.88 would flip the broader structure bearish.

The bearish bias is confirmed but the setup has expired: price at 52.53 sits well below the 54.38 entry, so the original short trigger was never re-engaged and the 1H down trend (last candle 52.63→52.53, -0.18%) is now decelerating rather than extending. Structure is unchanged — 4H bearish, combined SELL, no open FVGs to act as a magnet — leaving 50.14 as the downside target and 54.38–54.61 as the invalidation band. The key change from the prior read is momentum: the earlier -0.97% push has flattened to -0.18% with price holding above 52.38, so the extension has stalled even as direction stays down. Bias remains bearish; a sustained reclaim above 54.61 flips it toward 58.61, while a clean break of 52.38 reopens the path to 50.14.

Bias stays SELL: price has edged up to 4,023.72 from the prior 4,019.28, but the 4H/1H alignment remains bearish and the 3,978.18 lower pivot is still the immediate downside target and entry trigger. The 1H downtrend persists (-0.07% on the last bar) and the FVG book remains empty, so there is no overhead draw to stall the move. A break of 3,978.18 activates the short (stop 3,986.75, target 3,873.53), while 4,082.82 remains the invalidation of the bearish read; until reclaimed, rallies toward 4,047–4,063 stay sellable.

Price ticked up to 1.30 from 1.29, and the combined 4H+1H alignment has shifted from SELL to HOLD, so the prior SELL bias is softened rather than confirmed. The 1H is still trending down, but the last 1H candle closed up at 1.31, and a bull FVG has opened at 1.2954–1.302 — the same zone that previously held as support — giving the bounce a foothold. The 1.3211–1.3246 bear FVG remains the overhead cap, and the expired BUY at 1.32 with a 1.38 target stays void; 1.32 is resistance, not an entry. Bias is now neutral-to-softly-bearish between the 1.25 lower pivot and 1.32 upper pivot, with invalidation unchanged: a decisive close above 1.32 that fills the upper bear FVG flips the case bullish, while a break below the 1.2954 bull FVG reopens the path to 1.25.
